name: Reading Truck
old_description: Our highly experienced Reading Truck team in Salt Lake City has the knowledge you need to deliver the work truck you want. Specializing in custom fabrication – from ladder racks to bed modifications and more – we provide competitive quotes and have extensive inventory from top quality vendors, saving you time and money.
about:
Reading Truck operates a full-service upfitting and repair center at 4285 West 1385 South in Salt Lake City, Utah. The location is part of a national network of Reading Truck centers and authorized distributors, providing local service backed by a broader organization.

The facility specializes in commercial truck and van upfitting, including service body installations, custom van configurations, ladder racks, toolboxes, and specialized compartments. Technicians handle custom fabrication, bed modifications, and fleet maintenance programs ranging from preventive maintenance to emergency repairs. The shop also offers mobile field service, crane and liftgate inspections, DOT compliance work, and ASME R-Stamp certified tank testing. A retail store, showroom, and parts counter stock air compressors, cargo control, lighting, trailers, and replacement parts from leading manufacturers.

Customers span construction, HVAC, telecommunications, utilities, and landscaping sectors, as well as fleet managers overseeing vehicles from Sprinter vans to semi-trailers, flatbeds, dump bodies, garbage trucks, and snowplows.

The company emphasizes a one-year warranty on upfitting work, premium materials suited to Utah’s climate extremes, and the convenience of a national support network for customers whose work travels beyond the region.
